claim: Additional semantic tasks per fixed source/context improve transfer beyond repetition at matched exposure and compute.

arms.training: one preselected canonical task per eligible world/context stratum, repeated
multiple semantic tasks from the same token-matched strata

matching.source_schedule: identical issuer/context ordering and occurrence counts
matching.multi_task_K: up to 8, actual common K >=2 frozen from training-only feasibility before evaluation
matching.single_selection: deterministic seed selection with family balancing, never eval outcomes
matching.budget: derive exact tokens and steps from frozen paired schedule; no numerical budget/results assigned here
matching.no_support_action: Do not train/claim this comparison if matching support is insufficient; no text padding or question editing to force matches.
matching.scope_limit: Controlled matched cohort is not automatically representative of the complete task bank.

evaluation_cells.limitation: AMD already in legacy train; isolated batch only, one issuer is a case study, not population-wide generalization.

evaluation_cells.split: future separate source-snapshot protocol with disjoint source/vintage/content components
evaluation_cells.status: not established by current catalog; no ID-only pseudo instances

evaluation_cells.holdout: aggregate(sum, filter(collect(...))) skeleton with eligible source-bound tasks; keep primitive filter/aggregate in train
evaluation_cells.rule: hold all matching structure/argument-role cases and variants, not question hashes

metrics.primary: structured JSON exact match under compiler unit/period/tie/rounding contract
metrics.uncertainty: report paired seed variation; cluster related task views; one AMD issuer cannot support cross-issuer confidence intervals

prerequisites: explicit compatible trainer messages adapter; old B5/v4 is not automatically compatible
actual model/checkpoint availability and full-message sequence-limit check
freeze optimizer/precision/adapters/hyperparameters and budget before AMD evaluation
source-rights and independent KMS/production/package approval remain separate unresolved release gates

evaluation_decoding.policy: same deterministic decoding policy and frozen generation cap for every arm
evaluation_decoding.format: value-free output-schema instruction shared across arms; no gold values or answer-dependent array lengths
evaluation_decoding.parsing: predeclared strict JSON parsing and compiler semantics, not post-hoc answer substring extraction
